added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: _is_grammar_full_match detects an inline segment grammar by requiring the literal substring A-Za-z9 in the pattern argument's unparsed text, so a re-spelling of the same character class in another order or escape (e.g. re.fullmatch(r"[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+", section_id)) escapes the guard even though it composes the segment grammar inline over a section id; verified by mutating _store.py in a scratch tree, which leaves the pin green (EXIT=0). The guard is narrower than its docstring's claim that no function composes the segment grammar inline.

follow-on: the assertion inline - _SEGMENT_GRAMMAR_NON_SECTION == set() names its exceptions by (function, argument), so a legitimate new non-section use of the segment grammar in a new function reddens the pin with no regression; verified by adding a function that full-matches the same grammar over a slug argument in a scratch tree (EXIT=1). The deliberate exception edit it forces is a mitigant, but the red-without-regression shape is the brittleness §20 exists to remove.
